body.name: omega_ell_R
body.def: For \(\delta\ge0\) and \(\zeta\in\mathcal O_{\ell,R}\), \(\omega_{\ell,R}(\delta;\zeta)=\operatorname{diam}\bigcup\{\mathcal B_{\ell,R}(\zeta'):\zeta'\in\mathcal O_{\ell,R},\ \lVert\zeta'-\zeta\rVert_{\infty}\le\delta\}\in[0,\infty]\); the union is nonempty because it contains \(\mathcal B_{\ell,R}(\zeta)\).
